source_handle:
*11 Implant restoration: Number of implants: 1; Implant type: Aojitai; Model: 3.75*10mm. Disposition: Doctor has performed
Obligation to inform, the patient gives full informed consent and signs the "Informed Consent Form for Implantation". Routine disinfection and draping. 4% articaine 1.7mlX1 tube local immersion
Under moist anesthesia, make a horizontal incision on the top of the alveolar ridge, incise the mucoperiosteum in full thickness, flap, position, prepare the hole to the predetermined depth, and place the implant with 35N.
No.: 3.75*10mm. Screw in the healing abutment (4.5*5). Tension reduction and suturing are available, and the filming position can be adjusted. Phase 3 restoration is planned after April
